parameters.name: PolicyName
parameters.description:
The name of the permission policy.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphen (-).

parameters.name: PolicyType
parameters.description:
The type of the permission policy. Valid values:

*   Custom
*   System

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager list-policy-versions --policy-type Custom --policy-name OSS-Administrator --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
